summary: Kandi Technologies furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing audited financials of Rawrr Inc. for FY2025 and unaudited pro forma combined financials of Kandi, tied to the previously disclosed Rawrr Acquisition announced December 11, 2025. The filing supplies the financial statement requirements for that completed acquisition, updating the record with target audited accounts under PCAOB standards and pro forma effect as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025. No new price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, break fee or closing date is stated in this excerpt. Watch for closing mechanics, consideration mix and any subsequent amendments or earn-out disclosure.
